514:t_1:4.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「...With $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s forces cut in half all at once, $$フロンタル$$ will naturally make a move too.」

514:t_1:5.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「$$スメラギ$$ and the others think $$ネオ・ジオン$$ will pressure $$ザフト$$ to commit all its forces.」

514:t_1:6.en:
$$マリー$$
「We're heading to $$プラント$$ to keep that in check, then.」

514:t_1:7.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「So what's $$ザフト$$ doing? They seem to be turning up in skirmishes, but we've barely encountered them.」

514:t_1:8.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Although $$ザフト$$ promised cooperation, it seems they've maintained a cautious stance on committing forces.」

514:t_1:9.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「That said, $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s forces are overwhelming in space, so there have been few occasions requiring $$ザフト$$ to deploy.」

514:t_1:10.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Is their leader the one holding back their forces...?」

514:t_1:11.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$ザフト$$'s leader... Defense Committee Chairman $$レイ・ザ・バレル$$...」

514:t_1:13.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I never thought $$レイ#pt136$$ would be $$ザフト$$'s commander...」

514:t_1:14.en:
$$パーラ$$
「I understand the history of the $$コーディネイター$$s, but I still can't accept selling Earth out to $$サイデリアル$$ because of it.」

514:t_1:19.en:
$n
「$$スメラギ$$ has decided to send an infiltration team to investigate the situation in $$プラント$$.」

514:t_1:20.en:
$$キラ$$
「Sitting here with your knees pulled up won't change anything. Come with us, $$シン$$.」

514:t_1:22.en:
$$キラ$$
「What do you want to do, $$シン$$?」

514:t_1:24.en:
$$シン$$
「I want to see $$レイ#pt136$$ and talk to him.」

514:t_1:26.en:
$$シン$$
「...The truth is, I'm... scared... when I think that $$レイ#pt136$$ might have changed...」

514:t_1:28.en:
$$キラ$$
「I understand how you feel, $$シン$$.」

514:t_1:29.en:
$n
「Just focus on seeing him. We'll help you do that.」

514:t_1:31.en:
$n
「Don't thank me. We'd do the same for each other.」

514:t_1:32.en:
$$シン$$
「Let me say it anyway. Thank you.」

514:t_1:33.en:
$n
「Save that for after the infiltration succeeds.」

514:t_1:34.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Be careful, $$シン$$. You too, $$キラ$$ and $n.」

514:t_1:35.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We'll all handle the diversion.」

514:t_1:36.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Once you're inside $$プラント$$, we'll back you up.」

514:t_1:38.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Of course I'm going too. I'm worried about $$メイリン$$.」

514:t_1:39.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So we still haven't heard from $$ラクス$$, $$バルトフェルド$$, or the others...」

514:t_1:40.en:
$$キラ$$
「They're all right, $$カミーユ$$. $$アスラン$$ is with $$ラクス$$ and the others.」

514:t_1:41.en:
$$キラ$$
「So, $$シン$$... Let's see $$レイ#pt136$$ first.」

514:t_1:43.en:
$$シン$$
($$レイ#pt136$$... Thanks to everyone, we've learned to choose our own way of life.)

514:t_1:44.en:
$$シン$$
(Everyone is helping me again... So I'll help you, no matter what.)

514:t_2:3.en: ～$$プラント$$ Defense Committee Chairman's　Office～

514:t_2:5.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「They've also gone on the offensive. This war will approach its end.」

514:t_2:6.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Are you telling $$ザフト$$ to act too?」

514:t_2:8.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「We've already dispatched several units. Any more would leave $$プラント$$ poorly defended.」

514:t_2:9.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$レイ・ザ・バレル$$... I understand your desire to protect the people of $$プラント$$.」

514:t_2:10.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「But unless we fundamentally change the way the world works, $$コーディネイター$$s will forever be treated as monsters from space.」

514:t_2:12.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Have you forgotten 《$$ラウ・ル・クルーゼ$$》's unfulfilled hopes?」

514:t_2:14.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$コーディネイター$$s are victims of $$クロノ$$, but you and he are the dark secrets born of $$クロノ$$'s blood.」

514:t_2:15.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「A man born into a $$クロノ$$ family sought greater power for his clan, and created $$ラウ・ル・クルーゼ$$ as an offering to become his successor...」

514:t_2:16.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「And you were his spare...」

514:t_2:17.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「...You too were given a role from birth.」

514:t_2:18.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「That is why I understand $$ラウ・ル・クルーゼ$$, and sympathized with the ideals of his friend, Chairman $$デュランダル$$.」

514:t_2:19.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Though I never imagined in those days that I would take the stage of history myself.」

514:t_2:20.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「$$ギル$$ sought to build a world that accepted fate determined at birth...」

514:t_2:21.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「The 《$$デスティニープラン$$》... Giving everyone in the world a mission as we were given would be the most efficient approach.」

514:t_2:22.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Many people rejected it during the $$多元戦争$$, though.」

514:t_2:24.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Looking at the world now, that was the very means of creating the future. That's why I became your ally.」

514:t_2:25.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'm grateful, $$レイ#pt136$$. Even with my backing, you could become Defense Committee Chairman because you were a former $$ザフト$$ $$赤服$$ close to the Chairman.」

514:t_2:26.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Give me your answer on full-scale $$ザフト$$ deployment soon. First, I ask you to deal with $c.」

514:t_2:28.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「I'll fulfill the true purpose of your $$デスティニープラン$$ without fail.」

514:t_2:32.en: ～$$プラント$$　$$アプリリウス市$$　Hidden Passage～

514:t_2:33.en:
$$キラ$$
「...Now that we're this far, we just have to go straight ahead.」

514:t_2:34.en:
$$シン$$
「$$デュオ$$, $$刹那$$, and the others are creating a diversion outside. Let's hurry.」

514:t_2:37.en:
$n
「I hear footsteps approaching. $$キラ$$, you and the others go on ahead.」

514:t_2:38.en:
$$シン$$
「You're going to hold them off alone?」

514:t_2:39.en:
$n
「I have $$ジークンドー$$ and $$ブーストアップ$$. And if I have to, I'll call $$ジェニオン$$.」

514:t_2:40.en:
$$キラ$$
「I understand. We'll leave this to you.」

514:t_2:42.en:
$n
(Don't worry, $$シン$$. I don't intend to die here either.)

514:t_2:43.en:
$n
(The footsteps are getting louder... They're coming...!)
